चिन्तामणि son of Harihara, grandson of Siddheśa, wrote
in 1573:

Abhidhānasamuccaya, Kaṃsavadha, Kādambarī-
rasa, Kṛtyapuṣpāñjali, Triśirovadha. Vāsudeva-
stava (in prose), Śambarāricarita.
